Download WWE 2K23 PPSSPP – PSP Iso Save and textures file, with improved graphics, realistic super stars, updated theme songs and more.

WWE 2K23 PPSSPP Wrestling game for is developed by 2ksports for PSP Emulator on Android, in which you can simulate the activities of World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) on your mobile phone.

WWE 2k23 PSP graphics has been improved, you can see every activities of the wrestlers being realistic, Wrestlers entrance Theme songs has been updated also.

Tag team division in WWE 2k23 PPSSPP is still present, this tag team means two wrestlers will fight other two opposing wrestlers, therefore as a player the choice is yours when choosing wrestlers to play with in the new updated roasters.

One ON One match is the most played features of this Wrestling game, you get to choose best rated wrestler and fight with another opposing wrestler, win the match and become victorious.

In WWE 2k23 PPSSPP – PSP Iso, there are fans that will always cheer you up during a fight, this in turn makes the WWE game look so interesting for you.

Royal Rumble, Road to wrestlemania features has been improved, now includes a more realistic features to make the game look more entertaining.

When you are about to start a match in the latest WWE 2k23 PPSSPP – PSP, you can choose from different arena to play, there are arenas such as NXT, WWE Raw, WWE SmackDown etc.

How To Install WWE 2k23 PPSSPP – PSP Iso Save Data Textures

In other to get WWE 2k23 PPSSPP – PSP running on your device you will need to learn steps on how to extract the iso save data textures files of the wrestling game below:

Steps To Extract WWE 2k23 PPSSPP – PSP:

  1. Open Installed Zarchiver Apk App.
  2. Locate and Click WWE 2k23 PPSSPP – PSP Iso…Rar file.
  3. From options menu that comes up, Click “Extract”.
  4. Click Device Memory from top of Zarchiver app interface (Please Don’t Enter Any Folder again, Just Stop in Internal Memory and Extract, the file will create a PSP folder or go into any existing PSP folder available).
  5. Click On Extract Icon, which looks like a arrow pointing downwards ⇓.
  6. Iso, Save Data, Textures files will be automatically extracted into PSP folder.
  7. Wait till extraction reached 100 %.
  8. Open PPSSPP Gold app or normal PPSSPP blue app.
  9. Locate WWE 2k23 in PSP folder after clicking Games Tab.

Note that after extracting the files above, the overall size of the game file will be 3.46 GB.
